images.name: ucore
images.description: Adds storage and NAS tools, Samba and NFS, snapshot and replication tools, and full wireless firmware.
images.audience: For a server that also looks after disks and shares.

startingStates.label: Fedora Atomic desktop or Fedora IoT

ui.invalid: This combination is not published. Choose another option.
ui.unavailable: No supported transition is defined for this starting state. Use the first-install guide.
ui.chooseStart: Choose your current system above to see the applicable steps. A new installation and an existing deployment need different instructions.
ui.architecture: The manifest selects x86_64 or aarch64 automatically. No architecture-specific tag is needed.

verification.label: Verify the published image / cosign required
verification.note: This checks the image signature. It does not enroll a Secure Boot key or replace the system signing policy.

fresh.label: First installation / prepare on another computer

steps.label: Use the auto-rebase template
steps.text: Set your credentials and replace both image references in the Butane template with {imageRef}. Read the install guide before running disk installation commands.

steps.label: Before changing the OS
steps.text: Back up application data and read the Secure Boot guidance before rebooting into a different kernel. This path starts from Fedora CoreOS, not a desktop Atomic system.

steps.label: Reboot into uCore
steps.text: Run the reboot command only after the rebase succeeds. The initial reference does not enforce the uCore image-signing policy.

steps.label: Once running uCore
steps.text: Continue only after you have booted uCore. Its installed signing policy enables the signed-reference step below.

steps.label: Reboot again
steps.text: After the signed rebase succeeds, reboot and confirm the booted signed reference.

steps.label: Check the booted deployment after reboot
Check the current deployment
steps.text: This path requires an existing bootc-managed uCore system with its container-signing policy intact. If an August 2026 image cannot fetch updates, read the recovery announcement first.

steps.label: Stage the selected image with policy enforcement
Apply on reboot
steps.text: After staging succeeds, check Secure Boot requirements and reboot when your workloads are ready.

steps.label: Confirm the booted image after reboot
Use the installed signing policy
steps.text: This path is for an existing uCore system still managed with rpm-ostree. Check Secure Boot before changing kernels.

steps.label: Apply on reboot
steps.text: After staging succeeds, reboot when your workloads are ready.

steps.label: Provision Fedora CoreOS instead
steps.text: uCore does not support rebasing from Fedora Atomic desktops or Fedora IoT. Start with a new Fedora CoreOS installation and an Ignition configuration.

combinations.description: A container and storage host with NAS tools, on the stable Fedora CoreOS base. No NVIDIA driver variant.
